entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann von Salis-Seewis was an Austro-Hungarian general who served during the First World War. Born in Karlovac, in the Kingdom of Croatia-Slavonia, he held senior commands in several theatres and was promoted to Feldzeugmeister in 1918.
